verdict.rationale: Phaser's editor (phaser.io/editor) offers a visual Scene Editor with Inspector-based tools (filters, particle emitters, layer organization) and an MCP server exposing 40+ tools for AI agents to manipulate scenes/assets via natural language, which is a form of programmatic automation. However, there's no evidence of a scripting API, plugin SDK, or documented way for developers to write custom editor extensions/tools themselves (as opposed to using the built-in AI agent or premade inspector features). missing for 10: documented editor plugin/extension API, custom tool SDK, examples of third-party editor scripts, and independent developer corroboration of extending the editor.
